svg.text: Not the build: fallbacks and the forbidden frame · dark

g.text: B1 fallback: Mirror in place, front
faces swap content; only if the B2 wrapper check fails
B1 fallback: in place, turned over
caption only; picture and marks unchanged
Turned over in your hands: same knot, same marks.
every gap moves to the other strand; curve fixed
draw(mirror(pd)) as authored = mirror knot labelled turned over (K17 false)
